messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: 5xx/429 spike on /v1/embeddings (eu-west). Metric: embeddings backend error rate -> 12% over last 3m, client QPS up 8x. Auto-pager -> alice.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident created: INC-20260317-1732. Oncall: @alice.

alice: I'm grabbing context. Is this a customer job or noisy anonymous traffic?

kate: kvcache miss rate jumped to 87% on apigw-eu-01 around 03:10. Redis latency up, eviction churn. Lots of small parallel requests (embed single-text). Likely scrape fanout hitting embeddings hotkeys.

mike: Confirmed. Top user agents = [python-requests, curl] from many IPs. ASN spike from a handful of cloud providers.

ellie: Support: seeing increased complaints from 2 customers about slow streaming. I'll prep a short status if impact persists.

alice: Triage plan: 1) immediate traffic shaping (geo slice + soft 429s) 2) enable WAF rule to block header fingerprint + tarpit 3) disable embeddings batch/async to reduce KV pressure 4) notify affected customers. Agree?

kate: +1. Recommend starting with soft rate-slice for anonymous API keys and bursty IPs. I'll flip kvcache read-only fallback to reduce redis writes.

ryan: I'm on the control plane changes. Applying rate-slice: `curl -XPOST https://controlplane/api/traffic/slice -d '{"filter":"ua:curl|python-requests,anonymous_key", "action":"rate_limit", "rate":2}'`

mike: WAF rule ready. Pattern: block requests with header `X-Client-Trace: empty` + UA fingerprint. Rolling to edge now. Rule id: WAF-6821.

alice: Executing embeddings route change to disable batch endpoint in eu-west: `redwood routes update /v1/embeddings --region eu-west --disable batch`

kate: kvcache read-only toggle done. Eviction pressure should drop. Watch for slowdowns as cache repopulates.

ellie: Drafting support note: "We are experiencing elevated latency for embeddings in EU. Mitigations in place; if you see sustained impact open a ticket and we'll prioritize." Will post if impact continues past 10m.

ryan: Rate-slice applied. Initial telemetry shows client QPS from top offending IPs down ~70% within 30s.

alice: WAF rule live. Also enabled tarpit for the worst ASNs (sleep 5s on new connections).

mike: Embeddings batch endpoint disabled in eu-west. Fewer concurrent KV writes observed. 5xx dropping to ~3% now.

kate: Monitoring: 5xx -> 1.6%, 429s spiked briefly then normalized. Redis p99 latency back to baseline.

ellie: Support note posted to customers with incident link.

alice: Good work. Next steps: keep measures for 30m, then gradually rollback slices if stable. Prepare a small post-incident summary for SRE channel. Anyone want handoff?

ryan: I'll stay on for 20 more minutes to watch.

mike: I'll follow up on WAF false positives; whitelist legitimate partners if needed.

kate: I'll run a quick post-mortem doc with timeline and root cause hypothesis (scraper + hot key kvcache churn).

incident-bot: Incident INC-20260317-1732 status -> mitigated. Updated: reduced error rate, active mitigations in place.

alice: Closing pager for now, keeping the thread open for notes. :thumbsup:

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident resolved by alice.

ellie: Filing a CX follow-up with the two customers who reported slowness.

ryan: final check: metrics stable for 10m, leaving monitoring alarms tightened for next 2 hours.

alice: Thanks team. I'll publish a short postmortem if anything else emerges.
